lines.en: label beachwars7:
scene afterthatyasuithing1
The dawning of a new day dies but an ending has begun.
lines.zh: 新一天的黎明死去,而一个结局已然开始。

lines.en: The one who spoke these words before was eaten by the sun.
lines.zh: 先前说出这句话的人,已被太阳吞没。

lines.en: That’s the millionth hint I’ve given you — this next line is the last one.
lines.zh: 这是我给过你的第一百万个提示——下一行就是最后一行。

lines.en: There’s a field not far from here I love in the web that God has spun.
lines.zh: 离这儿不远有一片田野,我爱它,就在上帝织出的网里。

the noon becomes the night and the night becomes the part of the game that we’re in right now
lines.zh: 正午变成夜晚,夜晚变成我们现在所处的这一段游戏

lines.zh: 总之,现在是特别解说环节,由我,你们这一幕的特邀主持兼导游,来解说说我们现在所在的这一幕,不过这一幕会很特别,所以抓好你们的袜子

lines.en: anyway you guys have been great i am the melon helmet in maya’s room that you probably saw in an event one time see you later bye i love you
lines.zh: 总之你们太棒了,我就是 Maya 房间里那个瓜皮头盔,你大概在某个事件里见过一次,回见,拜,我爱你

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing6
: Yasu, just what exactly did you say to Sana? The poor girl seemed utterly mortified.
lines.zh: : Yasu,你到底对 Sana 说了什么?那可怜的女孩看起来羞得无地自容。

lines.en: : Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana?

lines.en: : Yes. Sana. The girl you were just talking to. With black hair and only one eye.
lines.zh: : 对。Sana。你刚刚在跟她说话的那个女孩。黑头发,只有一只眼睛。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing7
: Hmm...
: I don’t really remember.
lines.zh: : 我不太记得了。

lines.en: : Everything seems a little fuzzy.
lines.zh: : 一切都模模糊糊的。

lines.en: : Did I make another mistake?
lines.zh: : 我又犯错了?

lines.en: : I doubt it would be a {i}mistake,{/i} but there is no way of knowing for sure without someone telling me what was discussed...
lines.zh: : 我倒觉得那不算{i}错{/i},不过没人告诉我你们聊了什么,也就无从确定……

lines.en: : Regardless, please be on your very best behavior going forward. Your contest is about to begin and, while I will be with you for the first half of it, the second lies entirely in your hands.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,接下来请务必表现得最好。你的比赛马上就要开始了,虽然前半程我会陪着你,但后半程完全掌握在你自己手里。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing8
: Contest?
lines.zh: : 比赛?

lines.en: : Lord, help me.
lines.zh: : 主啊,帮帮我。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing9
: He-
: Not yours, Yasu. {i}Anything{/i} but yours.
lines.zh: : 不是你的那个祂,Yasu。{i}千万{/i}别是你的那个。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing10
: Hmph! Mean Touka.
lines.zh: : 哼!坏 Touka。

lines.en: : Mean Touka, indeed. Now, come with me so we can review proper self-defense techniques and safety precautions before your departure.
lines.zh: : 坏 Touka,没错。现在,跟我来,我们出发之前先复习一遍正当防卫的技巧和安全注意事项。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing11
: Is this really how the entire weekend is going to be?
lines.zh: : 整个周末真的都要这么过吗?

lines.en: : Would’ve been like this even earlier if you hadn’t fuckin’ wandered off to god knows where. Sides, it ain’t like we’re enjoyin’ this shit either. I’m bored as fuck.
lines.zh: : 你要不是他妈的乱跑到鬼知道哪里去,早就这么过了。再说了,我们也没在享受这破事。我无聊死了。

lines.en: : I don’t particularly mind. I have actually been considering a second career in security since stand-up comedy doesn’t seem like it will be panning out for me anytime soon.
lines.zh: : 我倒不介意。其实我一直在考虑第二职业做安保,毕竟单口相声看起来短期内是混不出来了。

lines.en: : Good luck gettin’ hired. One thing I learned from goin’ around lookin’ for work is that nobody in this fuckin’ town is takin’ on any new employees.
lines.zh: : 祝你找得到工作。我到处找工作时学到的一件事是,这操蛋的镇上没人招新员工。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing12
: You’re still looking?
lines.zh: : 你还在找?

lines.en: : Course I’m still lookin’. Fuck else am I gonna do when I’m not watchin’ Chinami or dealin’ with your bullshit?
lines.zh: : 当然还在找。不看 Chinami、不处理你的破事的时候,我他妈还能干什么?

lines.en: : Just fuckin’ sucks cause I’ve had to go to like ten different interviews now and all of ‘em have just said “they’ll call me.” Fucking when? Cause I’m startin’ to think they ain’t callin’ at all.
lines.zh: : 就是他妈的烦,我到现在大概面了十家了,每一家都只说『会给我打电话』。到底他妈什么时候?我开始觉得他们根本不会打了。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing13
: Perhaps you are not making a strong enough first impression?
lines.zh: : 也许你给人的第一印象还不够强?

lines.en: : Or perhaps it’s the exact opposite...
lines.zh: : 或者恰恰相反……

lines.en: : Well, what kinda first impressions are these places lookin’ for? Cause I’ve been as nice and polite as I fuckin’ can but it’s like they all stop givin’ a shit the second they look at my application thing.
lines.zh: : 那这些地方到底想要什么样的第一印象?我已经他妈的尽量客气有礼了,可他们一看到我的申请表就像瞬间不在乎了。

lines.en: : It varies business to business. But I believe entering an interview with some sort of special skill would leave a strong first impression regardless of what company you are applying to.
lines.zh: : 每家公司都不一样。不过我相信,带着某种特殊技能去面试,不管应聘哪家公司,都能留下强烈的第一印象。

lines.en: : Skill? What kinda {i}skill?{/i} I ain’t got any skills.
lines.zh: : 技能?什么{i}技能{/i}?我什么技能都没有。

lines.en: : I have heard that juggling is not hard to grasp the basics of. Learning to do that might make for a more memorable interview if you hit them with it early.
lines.zh: : 我听说杂耍入门不难。要是你一上来就露一手,面试应该会更有记忆点。

lines.en: : Yeah, great idea. I’ll get right on that.
lines.zh: : 是啊,好主意。我马上去练。

lines.en: : Yumi...just out of curiosity, what are you writing down for your name on all of your job applications?
lines.zh: : Yumi……只是好奇,你在所有求职表的名字那一栏,填的是什么?

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing14
: Huh? What kinda fuckin’ question is that? I’m writin’ my name obviously. Don’t tell me that spot’s been a fuckin’ trick question this whole time?
lines.zh: : 哈?这他妈算什么问题?我当然填我的名字。别告诉我那一栏从头到尾都是个陷阱题?

lines.en: : And you’re absolutely sure you’ve been polite in all of your interviews?
lines.zh: : 那你确定自己在所有面试里都很礼貌?

lines.en: : Polite as I fuckin’ can be.
lines.zh: : 礼貌得不能再他妈礼貌了。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if that’s a yes or no.
lines.zh: : 我分不清这是 yes 还是 no。

lines.en: : Just get to the fuckin’ point, asshole. I ain’t got all night.
lines.zh: : 少废话,直接说重点,混蛋。我可没一整晚的时间。

lines.en: : Yes you do. We are on guard duty.
lines.zh: : 你有的是时间。我们在站岗。

lines.en: : Fuck off, Noodle Girl. I ain’t talkin’ to you.
lines.zh: : 滚开,面条妹。我不跟你说话。

lines.en: : Yumi, isn’t your family name directly tied to the Yakuza?
lines.zh: : Yumi,你的姓氏不是直接和黑道挂钩吗?

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing15
: Yeah. So?
lines.zh: : 是啊。怎么了?

lines.en: : So...if you {i}are{/i} doing everything else correctly, it’s possible your interviewers just take one look at your name and pass on you.
lines.zh: : 那……如果你其他方面都做对了,有可能{i}是{/i}面试官一看到你的名字就把你刷掉了。

lines.en: : Cause of the Yakuza shit? Why? Figured that’d be, like...a selling point or somethin’. Like hey, free protection or whatever.
lines.zh: : 因为黑道那破事?为什么?我还以为那算是……卖点什么的。比如嘿,免费保护之类的。

lines.en: : This might come as a surprise to you, but there are a lot of people out there who just don’t really want to be linked to any sort of organized crime.
lines.zh: : 这话也许会让你意外,但外面有很多人,是真的不想跟任何形式的有组织犯罪扯上关系。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing16
: The fuck am I supposed to do then?! I can’t just change my fuckin’ name!
lines.zh: : 那我他妈该怎么办?!我总不能改名字吧!

lines.en: : I will allow you to use mine. Yumi Arakawa has a nice ring to it.
lines.zh: : 我可以让你用我的。Yumi Arakawa 听起来不错。

lines.en: : No it fucking doesn’t!
lines.zh: : 个屁,一点都不他妈好听!

lines.en: : Arakawa Ramen does not sound like an effective name for a business. If we are ever wed, you will be taking my name.
lines.zh: : Arakawa Ramen 听起来不像个像样的店名。如果我们真要结婚,你会跟我姓。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing17
: The fuck is this about getting “wed?!” Don’t tell me this dude’s porkin’ {i}you{/i} too?!
lines.zh: : 结什么『婚』?!别告诉我这家伙也把{i}你{/i}『猪』了?!

lines.en: : Of course not. The only person who porks me is the meat delivery driver every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。唯一『猪』我的,是每周二、四、六来送肉的司机。

lines.en: : Not what that means, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思,Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : As if {i}you{/i} would know. I have been being porked ever since I was a child.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}懂什么。我从小就被『猪』到大。

lines.en: : In fact, I would not be surprised if I had been porked by {i}hundreds{/i} by now.
lines.zh: : 说实话,就算到现在已经被{i}几百{/i}个『猪』过,我也不会惊讶。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing18
: God, I can’t wait until this stupid fucking contest is over...
lines.zh: : 天哪,这场该死的蠢比赛赶紧结束吧……

lines.en: : It sounds to me like {i}someone{/i} needs to get porked.
lines.zh: : 听起来{i}有人{/i}需要被『猪』一下。

lines.en: : Just fuckin’ kill me instead, please.
lines.zh: : 还是直接杀了我吧,求你了。

lines.en: : Alright, alright! Who’s ready to get this show on the road?!
lines.zh: : 好了好了!各位准备好开始了吗?!

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing19
: We’ve got a whopping {i}two{/i} contests lined up for you guys tonight! And the first one begins in just a few minutes!
lines.zh: : 今晚我们给大家准备了{i}两{/i}场比赛!第一场几分钟后就要开始!

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing20
: Also, as a favor to Imani, we’ve decided to get both of the borderline-illegal competitions out of the way back-to-back so she’ll be able to rest all day tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 另外,看在 Imani 的面子上,我们决定把这两场半非法的比赛连着办完,这样她明天就能休息一整天!

lines.en: : Cause if caring about us wasn’t already enough, sharing a room with Sensei tonight is sure to take a heck of a lot out of her!
lines.zh: : 因为如果说关心我们还不够的话,今晚和 Sensei 共处一室,肯定会把她折腾得够呛!

lines.en: : Be gentle, Senpai. I’m delicate.
lines.zh: : 温柔点,Senpai。我很脆弱。

lines.en: : Step back, Miss Imai. No one approaches the target- not even another teacher.
lines.zh: : 退后,Imai 老师。谁都不准靠近目标——哪怕是另一位老师也不行。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Imani. I’ll take good care of you.
lines.zh: : 别担心,Imani。我会好好照顾你的。

lines.en: : Ew, ew, ew! Everyone shut the fuck up!
lines.zh: : 恶心恶心恶心!所有人都给我闭嘴!

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing21

: The night will begin with the ceremonial escorting of the hostages. And once that is taken care of, the main event shall commence and we’ll all get to watch Chika be sexy! Also, I’ll be there too I guess.
lines.zh: : 今晚将以护送人质的仪式开场。等那部分结束,主要活动就正式开始,大家都能看到 Chika 大秀性感了!另外我大概也会在场。

lines.en: : Woo! Go Uta! You’re hotter anyway!
lines.zh: : 哇哦!Uta 加油!反正你更辣!

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing22
: Hey! That’s totally not true but thank you for lying to me! And thank you for volunteering to handle the color commentary as well!
lines.zh: : 嘿!这完全不是事实,但还是谢谢你骗我!也谢谢你自告奋勇来做现场解说!

lines.en: : Looking forward to it!
lines.zh: : 好期待!

lines.en: : M-Me too! But...I think there’s something I’m not understanding. Kirin says...you two will be...modeling swimsuits for...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我……我也是!不过……我觉得有件事我没弄明白。Kirin 说……你们两个要……给 Sensei 当泳装模特?

lines.en: : Isn’t...Isn’t that a little...inappropriate?
lines.zh: : 那不是有点……不合适吗?

lines.en: : Yes! Look forward to it in just a short while!
lines.zh: : 是的!敬请期待,马上就到!

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing23
: But for now, let’s go over how this is going to work one more time!
lines.zh: : 不过现在,让我们再把流程过一遍!

lines.en: : As you may have noticed, our contestants are currently being blindfolded. These blindfolds are {i}not{/i} to be removed until Ayane and Yasu are deep within the jungles of Kumon-mi beach!
lines.zh: : 大家应该注意到了,我们的参赛者目前都被蒙上了眼睛。在 Ayane 和 Yasu 深入 Kumon-mi 海滩的丛林之前,这些眼罩都{i}不{/i}许摘下来!

lines.en: : Once they are, their escort will {i}remove{/i} their blindfold and make their way back to the rest of us! If {i}they{/i} don’t get lost as well, that is. That forest is pretty dense.
lines.zh: : 一旦到了,她们的护送者就{i}摘下{/i}眼罩,再自己回到我们这边来!前提是{i}她们{/i}自己也没迷路。那片林子可是相当密。

lines.en: : Anyway, once either Yasu or Ayane makes it back, the contest will end and the girl who returned will earn a point for her team!
lines.zh: : 总之,只要 Yasu 或 Ayane 有一个人回来,比赛就结束,回来的那个女孩为自己的队伍得一分!

lines.en: : What happens if neither of ‘em make it back?
lines.zh: : 要是她们俩都没回来呢?

lines.en: : Then we’ll all be in a lot of trouble and the Dorm Wars will be the least of our worries!
lines.zh: : 那我们麻烦就大了,宿舍战争就是我们最不需要担心的事了!

lines.en: : The contest begins in ten minutes! Say your goodbyes now, as this may very well be your final chance!
lines.zh: : 比赛十分钟后开始!现在就去告别吧,这很可能就是你们最后的机会!

lines.en: : Are you properly blinded, Ayane? Any last minute adjustments that need...adjusting?
lines.zh: : 眼罩戴好了吗,Ayane?还有什么临场的需要……调整的吗?

lines.en: : Are we really just...being left in the woods? Isn’t that a little too serious for a Dorm Wars contest?
lines.zh: : 我们真的就……被丢在林子里?对宿舍战争的比赛来说,是不是太认真了一点?

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing24
: I would trade places with you if I could. My druidic powers would make moving through the forest significantly easier than my dreaded {i}cooking{/i} contest will be tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话我真想跟你换。我的德鲁伊之力能让我在林子里行动轻松得多,总比明天那场可怕的{i}厨艺{/i}比赛强。

lines.en: : If only I could wildshape into a nice dinner. Then, all of my problems would be but whispers in the trees that you will soon find yourself surrounded by.
lines.zh: : 要是我能野性变形变成一顿美味的晚餐就好了。那样我所有的问题,不过是你们即将被包围其中的、树间的低语罢了。

lines.en: : Yeah...that helps a lot, Molly. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 是啊……真是帮了大忙,Molly。谢啦。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing25
: Are you actually worried, Lidearel? You’re typically the bravest of all of us. Save the Kendo Princess, but I’m not sure if she even understands fear.
lines.zh: : 你真的在担心吗,Lidearel?你一向是我们当中最勇敢的。除了剑道公主,不过我不确定她是否懂得恐惧。

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. I’m not really in the right headspace to be doing this right now. Nor do I have any idea how I’m even {i}going{/i} to do this without my phone.
lines.zh: : 有点吧,嗯。我现在的状态不太适合做这个。而且我完全不知道没有手机该怎么{i}完成{/i}。

lines.en: : We really do depend on technology nowadays, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们现在真是太依赖科技了,对吧?

lines.en: : Honestly...the only thing keeping me comfortable right now is that you’ll be escorting me out there. Because I don’t really {i}want{/i} to quit, but if it really comes down to it-
lines.zh: : 老实说……现在唯一让我安心的是,由你来护送我进去。因为我其实不{i}想{/i}退出,但如果真到了那一步——

lines.en: : I apologize for being the harbinger of unfortunate news, Ayane- but I’m unable to serve as your escort tonight. Which I am slightly thankful for because escort quests are the actual worst.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉由我来带来这个坏消息,Ayane——但今晚我不能当你的护送者。说实话我还有点庆幸,因为护送任务真是最烂的。

lines.en: : What? Then who-
lines.zh: : 什么?那谁——

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing26
: Hi! Are you almost ready to go?
lines.zh: : 嗨!你差不多准备好了吗?
: A……Ami?……

lines.en: : Lidearel has been feared and left her Insignia of the Horde at home. And as a member of the opposing team, I’m hesitant to dispel it for her.
lines.zh: : Lidearel 心怀恐惧,把她的『部落徽记』落在家里了。而作为对手队伍的一员,我不太想替她解除。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing27
: Afraid, huh?
lines.zh: : 害怕,嗯?

lines.en: : How come?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : You know I’ll be with you for half of it, right? And I’m really banking on you finding your way back so perverts like Molly, Noriko, and everyone else on the second floor don’t have to sleep at my house.
lines.zh: : 你知道前半程我会陪着你,对吧?而且我非常指望你能找回来,这样 Molly、Noriko 和二楼那一帮变态就不用睡在我家了。

lines.en: : Is there...maybe someone else who could...
lines.zh: : 有没有……也许别的什么人能……

lines.en: : Nope! I already volunteered and signed our names on the release form so the school isn’t liable if anything happens to us.
lines.zh: : 没有!我已经主动请缨,还在免责书上签了我们俩的名字,这样万一出事,学校就不用负责。

lines.en: : And by us I mostly mean you since I’ll know the way back.
lines.zh: : 而这个『我们俩』主要指的是你,因为我认得回去的路。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing28
: Uhh...Sensei?...Maya?...
lines.zh: : 呃……Sensei?……Maya?……

lines.en: : Sensei is busy being guarded and Maya is off doing Maya stuff. Probably looking at the stars or something. You know how she is.
lines.zh: : Sensei 正忙着被人看着,Maya 去做 Maya 的事了。大概在看星星之类的。你知道她什么德行。

lines.en: : A true astrologian, through and through.
lines.zh: : 一位真正的占星术士,彻头彻尾。

lines.en: : Hahah! Yup! That’s Maya alright!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈!对!这就是 Maya 没错了!

lines.en: : Ami...I...don’t really know if this...is something I want to...go through with...
lines.zh: : Ami……我……不太确定这是不是我想……做下去的事……

lines.en: : You say that like you expect me to hurt you! Hahah!
lines.zh: : 你这话说的,好像我会伤害你似的!哈哈哈!

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing29
: Why would you think that, Ayane? When have I ever done anything to hurt you before? I love you! Even {i}if{/i} you’re getting all distant and spending more time with Maya than me lately.
lines.zh: : 你为什么会那么想,Ayane?我什么时候做过伤害你的事?我爱你!{i}哪怕{/i}你最近变得疏远,跟 Maya 待在一起的时间比跟我还多。

lines.en: : I talked to her about it and things actually went really well! And I was hoping I’d be able to talk to you while we’re on our walk next.
lines.zh: : 我跟她谈过了,事情进行得非常顺利!我还希望等下散步的时候能跟你谈谈。

lines.en: : Sensei? Please? Come here?
lines.zh: : Sensei?求你了?过来一下?

lines.en: : He can’t hear you.
lines.zh: : 他听不见你。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing30
: Ah! There’s the whistle! We must be starting!
lines.zh: : 啊!哨声响了!我们要开始了!

lines.en: : Geh! Loudest feckin’ whistle I’ve ever heard. Nearly KO’ed me.
lines.zh: : 嘎!这他妈是我听过最响的哨子。差点把我震晕。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing31
: Come on! Let’s take our places so I can make it back before the modeling thing and make sure no one is too sexy!
lines.zh: : 走吧!我们去就位,这样我还能在泳装展示之前赶回来,确保没有人太性感!

lines.en: : Heheh...heh...
: Chin up, Lidearel.
lines.zh: : 抬起下巴,Lidearel。

lines.en: : Yasu...gets lost all the time, so...if anything, I’d say your chances are pretty good.
lines.zh: : Yasu……老是迷路,所以……要说的话,我觉得你的机会相当不错。

lines.en: : I don’t like this, Molly. I really don’t like this.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这样,Molly。我真的很不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : I’m sure...it’ll all be worth it in the end.
lines.zh: : 我相信……最终一切都会值得的。

lines.en: scene black
: And if it’s not, at least you’ll have tried.
lines.zh: : 就算不值得,至少你试过了。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing32
: Alright, boys and girls! Our contestants are blindfolded and ready to go!
lines.zh: : 好了,男孩女孩们!我们的参赛者已经蒙好眼睛,准备出发!

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing33
: As a reminder to our escorts, you are absolutely not, under any circumstances, allowed to provide assistance to your partner once they’re dropped off!
lines.zh: : 提醒一下各位护送者:一旦把同伴送到目的地,你们在任何情况下都绝对不许提供协助!

lines.en: : And that includes lending them {i}your{/i} phones as theirs have already been locked away.
lines.zh: : 这其中包括把手机借给她们,因为她们的手机已经被收起来了。

lines.en: : Well...at least Ayane’s has since Yasu doesn’t have a phone.
lines.zh: : 好吧……至少 Ayane 的是这样,毕竟 Yasu 没有手机。

lines.en: : Uta, are you absolutely sure this contest is not going to end horribly? Because I’m hesitant to take Yasu into the middle of the woods as this is...
lines.zh: : Uta,你真的确定这场比赛不会以惨剧收场吗?因为我实在不想把 Yasu 带进林子深处,这实在是……

lines.en: : Well, to make myself sound like a commoner — {i}really fucking stupid.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯,用你们平民的话说——{i}蠢得要死{/i}。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing34
: Woah! Since when does an upstanding lady like you have curse words in her vocabulary book?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦!像你这样品行端正的女士,什么时候把脏话加进词汇本了?!

lines.en: : I just think this is a terrible idea and that we should make these two compete in something else instead.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得这主意糟透了,我们该让她们两个比点别的。

lines.en: : I’m with Touka. This isn’t a good idea. If one of us gets lost-
lines.zh: : 我站 Touka。这主意不好。要是我们中有一个人走丢了——

lines.en: : If one of you gets lost, we’ll come find you. It’s not like Touka and I don’t know where we’re headed. It’s only you and Yasu who won’t know where you are.
lines.zh: : 要是你们中有一个走丢了,我们会去找。又不是 Touka 和我不知道该往哪儿走。搞不清自己在哪儿的只有你和 Yasu。

lines.en: : Plus, you’ve already signed the waivers. If you were gonna bail on us, you should have done it earlier.
lines.zh: : 再说,免责书你们都签了。要是想退出,早该说了。

lines.en: : Oh, yes. Earlier. When I was unable to find Yasu.
lines.zh: : 哦,对,早点。那时候我还找不到 Yasu。

lines.en: : Hey, not my fault she figured out how to take her leash off.
lines.zh: : 嘿,她学会怎么解开绳子可不是我的错。

lines.en: : The only leash I wear is one that binds me to God. And with His help, I will find my way home.
lines.zh: : 我唯一戴的绳索,是把我和上帝绑在一起的那条。而靠着祂的帮助,我会找到回家的路。

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing35
: Hah...I suppose it can’t be helped.
lines.zh: : 哈……看来是没办法了。

lines.en: : Any last words from the girls of the first floor before you’re marched off to your doom?
lines.zh: : 在被押赴末路之前,一楼的各位还有什么遗言吗?

lines.en: : Yes. Where’s Sensei? I have to tell him something.
lines.zh: : 有。Sensei 在哪儿?我得跟他说件事。

lines.en: : Just tell me instead and {i}I’ll{/i} deliver your message to him. I’m sure it’s nothing you have to keep secret, right?
lines.zh: : 跟我说就行,{i}我{/i}会把话带给他。反正也不是什么需要保密的事,对吧?

lines.en: : I’d just {i}really{/i} appreciate it if I could speak to him alone for-
lines.zh: : 我只是{i}真的{/i}很希望能单独跟他说——

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing36
: Sensei! Ayane wants to see you before she gets lost in the woods! Come on over and give her a kiss goodbye!
lines.zh: : Sensei! Ayane 想在进林子迷路之前见你一面!过来给她一个告别之吻吧!

lines.en: : Thank you, Uta. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Uta。谢谢你。

lines.en: : I’m-
: Nuh-uh. You ain’t goin’ anywhere. Not until I can get eyes on Pinkie.
lines.zh: : 不行不行。你哪儿也不许去。在看到 Pinkie 之前不行。

lines.en: : Maya is not currently present either. And I am unwilling to let you leave your designated standing spot until she reappears.
lines.zh: : Maya 目前也不在场。在她重新出现之前,我不会让你离开指定的站位。

lines.en: : Ayane, just yell it to me. I can’t come over there.
lines.zh: : Ayane,直接喊给我听吧。我过不去。

lines.en: : Uhh...Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 呃……你确定?

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing37
: Are {i}you{/i} sure, Ayane?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}确定吗,Ayane?

lines.en: : The suspense is killing me. What will she say?! How will he respond?!
lines.zh: : 悬念快把我杀死了。她会说什么?!他会怎么回应?!

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing38
: I love you!
lines.zh: : 我爱你!

lines.en: scene afterthatyasuithing39
: Gah! How anticlimactic! It was only the same thing we’ve heard her say a million times before!
lines.zh: : 嘎!太扫兴了!只是我们听她说过一百万次的同一句话!

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Anyway! Now that our goodbyes and final words are out of the way...escorts! Take your gals to the middle of nowhere and do what ya please with ‘em!
lines.zh: : 总之!既然告别和遗言都说完了……护送者们!把你们的姑娘带到荒郊野外,然后爱怎么对她们就怎么对她们吧!

lines.en: : Just don’t make it super handsy since we had a clause about that on the waiver thing in...uhh...sub...section...I don’t know. Ask Makoto whenever she gets back.
lines.zh: : 只是别太动手动脚,因为我们的免责书里有这么一条,在……呃……第……几款来着。等 Makoto 回来问她。

lines.en: : But for now...get the heck out of here! Go, go, go!
lines.zh: : 不过现在……赶紧给我滚吧!去,去,去!
